subject: Anglais
title: Anglais · Terminale · Grammaire · Passif et structures de discours
description: Règles et automatismes — passif et structures de discours.

cards.front: Reformule : People say that the policy works.
cards.back: The policy is said to work.

cards.front: Reformule : People believe that he lied.
cards.back: He is believed to have lied.

cards.front: Traduis : « Il s'est fait licencier. »
cards.back: He got fired.

cards.front: Traduis : « Ils ont fait vérifier les données. »
cards.back: They had the data checked.

cards.front: Mets au passif : I dislike people interrupting me.
cards.back: I dislike being interrupted.

cards.front: Rapporte avec deny : “I didn't leak it,” she said.
cards.back: She denied leaking it.

cards.front: Rapporte avec accuse : “You lied,” he said to her.
cards.back: He accused her of lying.

cards.front: Rapporte avec urge : “Act now,” they told the government.
cards.back: They urged the government to act.

cards.front: Traduis : « Il prétend avoir trouvé une solution. »
cards.back: He claims to have found a solution.

cards.front: Traduis : « La mesure semble avoir échoué. »
cards.back: The measure seems to have failed.
